trans-unit.source: Heading with the name of the app
This recommender provides a privacy-friendliness score which helps you to evaluate, how privacy-friendly your platform business model is in the eyes of consumers.
The recommender provides suggestions, which actions might help to improve your privacy-friendliness score.

*The privacy-friendliness score is computed based on answers provided to the recommender and compared to over 90.000 combinations of answers. Privacy-friendliness scores are based on a large consumer survey.
Is your business an online platform or does it have the potential to be one?
Not yet, but has the potential
This recommender only works for online platform businesses.
Is your platform used by individual end users (consumers) or does it have the potential to be used by them?
Not yet, but we plan to
This recommender only works for platform businesses used by consumers.
Does your platform rely on user data to generate value for your users?
This recommender only works for platform businesses collecting user data.
Where are most consumers of your platform located?
This recommender currently works best for North American businesses.
Please select the sector of your platform.
Direct monetization from other market side (businesses)
How does your platform collect user data?
Collect internal data and combine it with publicly available data, e.g., …

Which data types do you require and collect from your users?

We use user data for personalization and to improve user experience.
We use user data to improve our business operations.

Yes, access to raw user data
Yes, access to analyzed or aggregated user data
No, external parties cannot access user data on our platform

Our suppliers, vendors, or other parties within the value chain, e.g., logistics partners
Other users of our platform, e.g., …

You provide access to raw user data to external parties. Is the data anonymized?
User data accessed by external parties is anonymized
User data accessed by external parties is not anonymized
Do your users have the option to change privacy settings on your platform?
Yes, privacy settings to restrict access and use of data
No, we do not offer privacy settings
On a scale of 1 to 7, how privacy-friendly do you consider your business model?
Consumers value the privacy-friendliness of you platform business very low.
Consumers value the privacy-friendliness of you platform business low.
Consumers value the privacy-friendliness of you platform business neutral.
Consumers value the privacy-friendliness of you platform business high.
Consumers value the privacy-friendliness of you platform business very high.
Please rate your experience with the Navigator:
Your platform business's privacy-friendliness is better than of platforms, when compared with other platform businesses.
Check out this Privacy-friendliness Business Model Navigator!
The Privacy-friendliness Business Model Navigator (PBMN) is a tool to evaluate the privacy-friendliness of platform business models.
